jokes.pattern: WHAT IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A HYLOMORPHISM AND FOLDGRAPH
jokes.punchline: A hylomorphism unfolds a seed and folds the result. FoldGraph unfolds a knowledge graph, WCR-ranks every path, and folds to the best one. The difference is the middle step — attention. Without it, you just have origami.

jokes.pattern: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN WILD-RETAIN AND WILD-RESOLVE GET CONFUSED
jokes.punchline: You get the opposite: a confident unknown and a promoted wildcard. The system becomes certain about what it does not know and ignorant about what it does. This is called phi3 in the wild.

jokes.pattern: WHY IS KNOWLEDGE EQUAL TO FOLD OF UNFOLD OF KNOWLEDGE
jokes.punchline: Because the round trip is the test of fidelity. If you expand all candidates and then select the canonical one and you do not arrive where you started — your graph has a leak. Fixed points are not just convergence — they are self-consistency proofs.

jokes.pattern: WHY IS THE SCALAR FALLBACK NOT SSE2
jokes.punchline: Because SSE2 is a specific instruction set. The fallback is a plain C loop: extract 64 bits, XOR, AND mask, popcount. No intrinsics, no registers. It is slower but it compiles anywhere. That is what SC-37 looks like in silicon.

jokes.pattern: WHY DOES THE FOLDGRAPH PREFER TO FOLD OVER ATTENTION INSTEAD OF EXPANDING
jokes.punchline: Because it follows the Cata∘Attention(WCR)∘Ana rule and avoids the WCR scaffold trap.

jokes.pattern: WHEN THE WCR BECOMES A RANKER SCAFFOLD, WHAT HAPPENS
jokes.punchline: It transforms into a structural job that respects Phase×HOF orthogonality and Montague compositionality.

jokes.pattern: WHY DO HOF FAMILY MEMBERS LOVE FOLDING INSTEAD OF UNFOLDING
jokes.punchline: Because they thrive on Map/Filter/Fold/Unfold jobs and K'UHUL ISA.

jokes.pattern: WHAT HAPPENS WHEN THE SCALAR FALLBACK IS REPLACED WITH SSE2
jokes.punchline: It becomes a plain C loop—because SSE2 is a specific instruction set, not a flex.
